campaign: Integrated validation, GUI cleanup lane: validate, harden and simplify the HTML workbench
doctrine: GUI cleanup lane (overgo_gui_cleanup), branched from master 3a331e81 on 2026-09-22. Scope: validate, harden and simplify the embedded HTML workbench (internal/server/webui and the server contracts it calls). Capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework; rows that need native audio, speech-document admission (master row speech-document-admission) or training-loop producers stay with their owning lanes and are not carried. Baseline measured at 3a331e81: every page acceptance passes and the screens walk captures 104 states at 2 viewports in 2 colour schemes with 0 layout findings, so the order is correctness of client contracts, stream and listener lifecycle, per-tab mount health, accessibility, consolidation, then style and the four GUI improvements that consume capabilities master already serves. Every layout or interaction change is reviewed in the browser pane at desktop and phone widths in both colour schemes before landing, and its acceptance is a browser leg or Go test that fails without the change; a consolidation that removes code holds a ratchet instead. A step's machine check is set with plan -setverify; a check whose real prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE rather than a pass. Preserve the conversation-first design: flat messages, lists and separators, no cards, reachable Send/Stop, one compact model selector, mobile drawer, settings on demand, status only for progress, failure or required action; keep the same-origin client, CSP and authenticated transport. Lane cycle: merge current master (never its plan.json) before each row when master has moved, re-plan from the merged tree, execute one row, gate. The lane plan never merges into master; publishing lane commits to master needs separate owner authorization. Bind read-only reference stores with OVERGO_SMOKE_REFERENCE_STORE and OVERGO_AUDIO_REFERENCE_STORE at C:/Users/jeffm/overgo/overgodb-store; the data root and browser output stay in this worktree. Merged master 79f5dd18 on 2026-09-23 (8b77d24e): suites now run in parallel (TestSuitesRunInParallel), so every browser leg awaits the state it asserts instead of relying on serial timing, and the catalog gained an image-embedding task the workbench offers no surface for yet (row gui-declared-task-output names it rather than building one: capability freeze).
